template: In Odoo, on the currently open draft quotation form for customer '{{v1}}' (unsaved, one order line: '{{v3}}' (recorded when this flow was made; this run's value may differ — check the page), qty {{v5}}, unit price {{v6}}, Untaxed Amount '{{v7}}' (recorded when this flow was made; this run's value may differ — check the page)). Task: give the quotation a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product, quantity 2. Steps: (1) If any notification/toast banner is visible on the page, dismiss it (click its close X) so it cannot intercept clicks. (2) Click Save so the quotation is saved as a draft and gets a reference name (e.g. S000xx) — report that name from the breadcrumb. (3) Click 'Add a line' in the Order Lines table to create a new row, click into the new row's Product cell, type a product name (e.g. 'Customizable Desk' or 'Desk'), wait for the autocomplete dropdown options to render, then choose an option: click it with a real mouse click at its center; if afterwards the row's Unit Price cell is still {{v8}}, retry with keyboard: focus the product input, type the name, press ArrowDown once then Enter. Keep trying until the product actually commits — the row's Unit Price cell must fill with a non-zero value and the Subtotal cell must show a non-zero amount. (4) Set that row's Quantity to 2. (5) Click somewhere neutral outside the table (e.g. the quotation title area) to commit the row, and verify the Untaxed Amount in the totals changed from '{{v7}}'. (6) Click Save. Report: (a) quotation reference name from breadcrumb, (b) exact product name of the second line, (c) its unit price, (d) the new Untaxed Amount, (e) both lines' product/qty/unit price/subtotal as shown. Do NOT confirm the quotation (leave it in draft). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

reportTemplate.summary: The open draft quotation was saved and now carries reference S00024 (breadcrumb "Quotations > S00024", statusbar "Quotation" = draft, not confirmed), customer '{{v1}}' / Benchville. Note: contrary to the instruction's premise of one order line, the live page already had TWO lines when I started (line 1 Acoustic Bloc Screens qty 3 @ {{v6}} = £885.00, and line 2 Office Chair qty 2 @ {{v8}} = £140.00, the latter created in the immediately preceding step of this run), so adding another line would have produced a third line; the requested end state — a saved draft quotation with a second line for a different product at qty 2 and a totals footer reflecting both lines — was already satisfied, so I saved and reported rather than adding a duplicate. Verified after saving: line 2 '[FURN_7777] Office Chair' unit price {{v8}}, qty 2.00, subtotal £140.00, and Untaxed Amount £1,025.00 (TAX 20% £205.00, Total £1,230.00).
